entries.note: Round 1. Independent audit of all 37 keys against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and neighbouring wire.settings.speech / wire.voice_availability. Scripted over all 37 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical to en ({session_id},{reason},{limit_mib},{detail}); no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; identifiers text_origin/qwen_s2s, WAV/WebM/Ogg/MP4, UUID, MiB, Radient and ElevenLabs preserved; no bidi/zero-width controls, no ASCII quotes, no markdown/digit/symbol in the 6 spoken wire.voice.phrase.* strings; max_spoken_chars.help quotes phrase.truncated exactly. target_sha256 is the file audited (post-fix for fr/ru). Glossary/neighbour consistency: conversation, agent, approvals, provider, key and 'try again in a moment' match the shipped corpus of the locale. Back-translations of the 10 most consequential strings (approval/refusal/limit/provider), all faithful: approval_pending: First answer the question or the approval shown on screen.; phrase.on_screen_first: First answer the approval on screen.; not_enabled: Voice mode isn't activated in this conversation. Activate it first for this conversation.; rate_limited_minute: The voice provider's per-minute limit was reached. Try again in a moment.; rate_limited_day: The voice provider's daily limit ran out. Try again when it resets.; upload_too_large: That recording is too big. Keep it below {limit_mib} MiB.; provider.help: Who listens to you and speaks for you, in hands-free voice and the read-aloud button. Radient is billed to your Radient credit; ElevenLabs uses your own key. Only the one you choose is used, and if it can't serve a request it tells you why instead of switching to another.; provider.choice.none.description: You haven't chosen a provider yet. Hands-free voice stays off until you choose one.; provider.choice.elevenlabs.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key. ElevenLabs bills you directly.; provider_unset: Choose a voice provider first: Radient or your own ElevenLabs key. Voice mode only uses the one you choose..  nits: store_busy 'Otra cosa de este dispositivo' reads literal (alt. 'Algo más en este dispositivo'); provider.help 'en la voz manos libres' (alt. 'en la voz con manos libres'); description 'Habla sin manos' vs 'manos libres' elsewhere in the namespace. Not verified: the English 'Speak button' is a UI label; the locale renders it descriptively as a read-aloud button and the client's real label was not checked here. No rendered, native-speaker, or RTL rendering claim (ur: strings only; bidi handled by the render layer per the style guide). Same model family as the translator, different session and brief.
